id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

number.description: A unique bus identification number (positive integer).

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations. This field should not be confused with the ISOLATED enum value.

bustype.description: Used to describe the connectivity and behavior of this bus. in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing

angle.description: Angle of the bus. Units: rad.

magnitude.description: Voltage as a multiple of `base_voltage`. Units: pu.

voltage_limits.description: Limits on the voltage variation as multiples of `base_voltage`. Units: pu.

area.description: ID of the area containing the bus.

load_zone.description: ID of the load zone containing the bus.
